notes.title: Edge of Elsewhere - Demo now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10409284/533571abf49be30484502b64d79ea20a72eb83ce.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1420630/Edge_of_Elsewhere/

Join Saskia Hawthorn as she enrols at the Royal Academy of Automagic, learns to gather and craft over 300 unique magical items, woos and befriends a large cast of colourful characters and accidentally summons a cute genie prince(??) in this alchemical otome dating simulation game!

We hope you enjoy this two-month sampler of Saskia's boy-wooing adventures. Be sure to wishlist Edge of Elsewhere for further updates!
